transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I keep planning my days around not having to drive over high bridges. It's just getting to be a pain. And if I can't find a route around it and I absolutely have to cross one, I just white-knuckle the steering wheel the whole way over. I figured it was finally time to talk to somebody about it.
Do you feel this same fear in other situations besides high bridges?

No, not really. It's just the high bridges. I mean, I can fly on a plane just fine, and I don't mind being up in a tall building or anything like that. It's specifically just driving over those big bridges that gets to me.
